description: GY-AS7343 breakout board with ams OSRAM AS7343 14-channel multi-spectral sensor and on-board white LED

ports.label: VIN / GND
ports.note: VIN da placa GY-AS7343, com regulador + level-shifter a bordo, confirmado em 2–5 V pelo anúncio do vendedor (não é o VDD de 1,7–1,98 V do chip nu, que fica interno à placa). Corrente do chip via I2C, não inclui o driver do LED (4–134 mA) nem o consumo do regulador/level-shifter da placa, que não é publicado

ports.label: I²C 0x39 (SCL/SDA)
ports.note: pinos digitais do chip toleram até 3,6 V; o nível lógico da placa não está publicado

channels.description: 11 channels in the visible spectrum, 1 near-infrared, 1 clear and 1 flicker detection channel; roughly 380 to 1000 nm

supply-voltage.note: VDD of the chip; digital and analog pins tolerate up to 3.6 V. This is NOT the breakout board's input voltage — see board.supply-voltage below

board.description: GY-AS7343 breakout (PENGHEKEJI/generic, 4-pin VIN/GND/SCL/SDA) — on-board regulator plus I2C level-shifter

supply-voltage.note: VIN range as published by the seller on the specific listing purchased (AliExpress, item 1005008569505325: "AS7341 AS7343 com conversão de nível, fonte de alimentação 2-5V"); not an ams OSRAM datasheet figure, but the vendor spec for this exact board

current.note: does not include current through the LED driver pin

specs.flicker-detection: dedicated channel, flags ambient light flicker (e.g. 50/60 Hz)

led-driver.description: integrated LED driver (LDR pin) for the on-board white LED, used for reflective measurements

current-range.note: 7-bit LED_DRIVE field, register 0xCD; LED_ACT bit enables/disables the driver

communications.interface: I2C, 7-bit addressing, standard and full speed
communications.register-access: 8-bit auto-incrementing register pointer; 16-bit fields must be read low byte first (latching)

pinout.name: VIN
pinout.description: supply input to the board regulator

communications.extra-pins: the chip also provides INT (interrupt) and a programmable GPIO for trigger/sync; check whether this board breaks them out
